source.text_it: Secondo quanto stabilito dal regolamento 561/2006/CE, il periodo di riposo giornaliero regolare è di otto ore

records.localized_text: Under Regulation (EC) No 561/2006, the regular daily rest period is eight hours.

source.text_it: Secondo quanto stabilito dal regolamento 561/2006/CE, il periodo di riposo giornaliero è un periodo durante il quale il conducente non può disporre liberamente del proprio tempo

records.localized_text: Under Regulation (EC) No 561/2006, the daily rest period is a period during which the driver cannot freely dispose of their time.

source.text_it: Secondo quanto stabilito dal regolamento 561/2006/CE, il periodo di riposo giornaliero ridotto è quarantacinque minuti ogni quattro ore e mezza di guida

records.localized_text: Under Regulation (EC) No 561/2006, the reduced daily rest period is forty-five minutes for every four and a half hours of driving.

source.text_it: Il regolamento 561/2006/CE prevede che il periodo di riposo settimanale regolare è di almeno 45 ore

records.localized_text: Regulation (EC) No 561/2006 provides that a regular weekly rest period is at least 45 hours.

source.text_it: Il regolamento 561/2006/CE prevede che il periodo di riposo settimanale ridotto debba essere recuperato

records.localized_text: Regulation (EC) No 561/2006 provides that a reduced weekly rest period must be compensated.

source.text_it: Il regolamento 561/2006/CE prevede che il periodo di riposo settimanale ridotto abbia una durata minima di 24 ore ininterrotte

records.localized_text: Regulation (EC) No 561/2006 provides that a reduced weekly rest period must be at least 24 uninterrupted hours.

source.text_it: Il regolamento 561/2006/CE prevede che il periodo di riposo settimanale possa essere di tipo regolare o ridotto

records.localized_text: Regulation (EC) No 561/2006 provides that a weekly rest period may be regular or reduced.

source.text_it: Il regolamento 561/2006/CE prevede che il periodo di riposo settimanale regolare sia di almeno 30 ore

records.localized_text: Regulation (EC) No 561/2006 provides that a regular weekly rest period is at least 30 hours.

source.text_it: Il regolamento 561/2006/CE prevede che il periodo di riposo settimanale ridotto sia al massimo di 24 ore continuative

records.localized_text: Regulation (EC) No 561/2006 provides that a reduced weekly rest period is no more than 24 consecutive hours.

source.text_it: Il regolamento 561/2006/CE prevede che il periodo di riposo settimanale regolare non possa essere inferiore a 90 ore

records.localized_text: Regulation (EC) No 561/2006 provides that a regular weekly rest period cannot be less than 90 hours.

source.text_it: Il regolamento 561/2006/CE prevede che il conducente, a fronte di indennità in denaro, possa rinunciare al periodo di riposo settimanale

records.localized_text: Regulation (EC) No 561/2006 provides that a driver may forgo weekly rest in exchange for monetary compensation.

source.text_it: I tempi di disponibilità sono quelli nei quali il conducente, pur non dovendo necessariamente rimanere sul posto di lavoro, deve tenersi a disposizione per poter prontamente riprendere il lavoro

records.localized_text: Periods of availability are periods when a driver, while not necessarily remaining at the workplace, must be available to resume work promptly.

source.text_it: I periodi di permanenza a bordo del veicolo a fianco di un altro conducente (multipresenza) sono considerati tempi di disponibilità

records.localized_text: Periods spent on board beside another driver in a multi-manning arrangement are considered availability time.

source.text_it: I tempi di disponibilità sono convenzionalmente rappresentati dal simbolo in figura

records.localized_text: Availability periods are conventionally represented by the symbol shown.

source.text_it: I periodi di tempo impiegati per la piccola manutenzione del veicolo sono considerati "altri lavori"

records.localized_text: Time spent on minor vehicle maintenance is considered “other work.”

source.text_it: I tempi definiti "altri lavori" sono convenzionalmente rappresentati dal simbolo in figura

records.localized_text: Periods defined as “other work” are conventionally represented by the symbol shown.

source.text_it: I tempi definiti "altri lavori" sono considerati tempi di guida

records.localized_text: Periods defined as “other work” are considered driving time.

source.text_it: I tempi di disponibilità sono quelli durante i quali il conducente può disporre liberamente del proprio tempo

records.localized_text: Periods of availability are periods during which the driver may freely dispose of their time.

source.text_it: I periodi di tempo impiegati per la pulizia del veicolo son considerati "tempi di disponibilità"

records.localized_text: Time spent cleaning the vehicle is considered “availability time.”

source.text_it: I tempi definiti "altri lavori" sono convenzionalmente rappresentati dal simbolo in figura

records.localized_text: Periods defined as “other work” are conventionally represented by the symbol shown.

source.text_it: L'impresa di trasporto non può promettere premi in denaro al conducente basati sulla maggior percorrenza chilometrica

records.localized_text: A transport company may not promise drivers cash bonuses based on greater distance traveled.

source.text_it: Il conducente è corresponsabile per le infrazioni al regolamento 561/2006/CE, anche se commesse alla guida di un veicolo di proprietà dell’impresa

records.localized_text: The driver shares responsibility for breaches of Regulation (EC) No 561/2006, even when committed while driving a company-owned vehicle.

source.text_it: L'impresa di trasporto non deve incoraggiare i propri conducenti a violare le disposizioni in materia di tempi di guida e di riposo

records.localized_text: A transport company must not encourage its drivers to breach driving and rest time rules.

source.text_it: L'impresa di trasporto può decurtare lo stipendio al conducente che si rifiuti di guidare per più di 10 ore al giorno

records.localized_text: A transport company may deduct pay from a driver who refuses to drive more than 10 hours a day.

source.text_it: L'impresa di trasporto non risponde delle violazioni al codice della strada commesse, durante il lavoro, dai conducenti alle proprie dipendenze cui abbia fornito istruzioni in contrasto con il regolamento 561/2006/CE, perché tale responsabilità è esclusivamente del conducente

records.localized_text: A transport company is not liable for Highway Code violations committed at work by its drivers to whom it gave instructions contrary to Regulation (EC) No 561/2006, because only the driver is responsible.

rows.text: Regular daily rest is at least 11 consecutive hours; it can also be split into periods of at least 3 and 9 hours.
evidence: Regolamento (CE) 561/2006, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/ALL/?uri=CELEX%3A02006R0561-20241231, art. 4(g): definizione di riposo giornaliero regolare.

rows.text: During rest the driver can freely dispose of their time; this distinguishes it from work.
evidence: Regolamento (CE) 561/2006, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/ALL/?uri=CELEX%3A02006R0561-20241231, art. 4(f)-(g): definizioni di riposo e riposo giornaliero.

rows.text: The 45 minutes are a driving break, not reduced daily rest, which lasts at least 9 hours and less than 11.
evidence: Regolamento (CE) 561/2006, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/ALL/?uri=CELEX%3A02006R0561-20241231, artt. 4(g) e 7: riposo ridotto e interruzione della guida.

rows.text: Regular weekly rest consists of at least 45 consecutive hours, unlike reduced rest.
evidence: Regolamento (CE) 561/2006, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/ALL/?uri=CELEX%3A02006R0561-20241231, art. 4(h): definizione dei due riposi settimanali.

rows.text: The reduction must be compensated by an equivalent rest period taken in one block by the end of the third following week.
evidence: Regolamento (CE) 561/2006, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/ALL/?uri=CELEX%3A02006R0561-20241231, art. 8(6b): compensazione della riduzione.

rows.text: Reduced weekly rest can be less than 45 hours, but must last at least 24 consecutive hours.
evidence: Regolamento (CE) 561/2006, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/ALL/?uri=CELEX%3A02006R0561-20241231, art. 4(h): minimo del riposo settimanale ridotto.

rows.text: There are two forms: regular rest of at least 45 hours and reduced rest of at least 24 consecutive hours, subject to the applicable conditions.
evidence: Regolamento (CE) 561/2006, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/ALL/?uri=CELEX%3A02006R0561-20241231, artt. 4(h) e 8(6): definizioni e condizioni.

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSE: 30 hours is not enough for a regular weekly rest, which must last at least 45 hours. A 30-hour rest may instead count as a reduced weekly rest if the applicable conditions and compensation requirements are met.
evidence: Regulation (EC) 561/2006, consolidated 31 December 2024, art. 4(h), 8(6), 8(6b), 8(7): regular weekly rest at least 45 hours; reduced weekly rest at least 24 hours subject to conditions; reductions require equivalent compensation, attached to a rest of at least nine hours. https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/HTML/?uri=CELEX:02006R0561-20241231

Official superiori PDF question 27565, page 42 (zero-based), prints FALSO. The explanation reads the wording as a test of whether 30 hours suffices for regular weekly rest; that is an editorial interpretation, not a verified official rationale. It does not assert a mathematical contradiction or that every 30-hour weekly rest is invalid.

rows.text: The 24 hours are the minimum, not the maximum: reduced rest lasts less than 45 hours and at least 24 consecutive hours.
evidence: Regolamento (CE) 561/2006, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/ALL/?uri=CELEX%3A02006R0561-20241231, art. 4(h): definizione del riposo ridotto.

rows.text: The minimum regular weekly rest is 45 consecutive hours, not 90.
evidence: Regolamento (CE) 561/2006, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/ALL/?uri=CELEX%3A02006R0561-20241231, art. 4(h): minimo del riposo regolare.

rows.text: Weekly rest is mandatory: payment cannot replace the required rest time.
evidence: Regolamento (CE) 561/2006, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/ALL/?uri=CELEX%3A02006R0561-20241231, art. 8(1), (6) e (6b): obbligo di riposo e compensazione in tempo.

rows.text: During availability the driver need not remain at the workstation, but must be ready to resume work; its foreseeable duration is known in advance.
evidence: Direttiva 2002/15/CE, art. 3(a)-(b), https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/ALL/?uri=CELEX%3A32002L0015: definizione e conoscenza preventiva della durata.

rows.text: When a vehicle is multi-manned, time spent beside the driver or in a bunk while it is travelling is availability.
evidence: Direttiva 2002/15/CE, art. 3(a)-(b), https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/ALL/?uri=CELEX%3A32002L0015: periodo passato accanto al conducente o in cuccetta durante la marcia.

rows.text: The square crossed by a diagonal indicates availability on the tachograph; it does not indicate other work.
evidence: Regolamento (UE) 165/2014, art. 34(5)(b), https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2014/165/oj/eng: simboli distinti per disponibilità e altri lavori.

rows.text: Technical maintenance is work other than driving and is recorded as other work.
evidence: Direttiva 2002/15/CE, art. 3(a)-(b), https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/ALL/?uri=CELEX%3A32002L0015: manutenzione tecnica tra le attività lavorative; Regolamento (CE) 561/2006, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/ALL/?uri=CELEX%3A02006R0561-20241231, art. 4(e): altri lavori.

rows.text: The figure shown does not match the crossed hammers: on a tachograph, these indicate other work, such as loading and unloading.
evidence: Original figure data/source/images/ce6a547b03e7a8142936f67893fc3f1dc97a6cd6f96e5faafe320e76ac69df24.png visually inspected: solid T-shaped mark, distinct from crossed hammers; no identity is inferred.

European Labour Authority, The Tachograph, https://www.ela.europa.eu/sites/default/files/2023-10/tachograph-road2fairtransport_EN.pdf : illustrated crossed-hammers symbol denotes other work such as loading and unloading.

rows.text: Other work includes work activities other than driving, such as cleaning and maintenance; it is recorded separately from driving.
evidence: Regolamento (CE) 561/2006, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/ALL/?uri=CELEX%3A02006R0561-20241231, art. 4(e); Direttiva 2002/15/CE, art. 3(a)-(b), https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/ALL/?uri=CELEX%3A32002L0015: attività di lavoro incluse pulizia e manutenzione.

rows.text: Being free to dispose of time characterizes rest. During availability the driver must be ready to resume work.
evidence: Regolamento (CE) 561/2006, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/ALL/?uri=CELEX%3A02006R0561-20241231, art. 4(f): riposo; Direttiva 2002/15/CE, art. 3(a)-(b), https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/ALL/?uri=CELEX%3A32002L0015: disponibilità.

rows.text: Cleaning the vehicle is a work activity and counts as other work, not availability.
evidence: Direttiva 2002/15/CE, art. 3(a)-(b), https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/ALL/?uri=CELEX%3A32002L0015: pulizia tra le attività lavorative; Regolamento (CE) 561/2006, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/ALL/?uri=CELEX%3A02006R0561-20241231, art. 4(e): altri lavori.

rows.text: The square crossed by a diagonal indicates availability. Crossed hammers indicate other work.
evidence: Regolamento (UE) 165/2014, art. 34(5)(b), https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2014/165/oj/eng: simboli distinti per disponibilità e altri lavori.

rows.text: A distance-based bonus is prohibited if it endangers road safety or encourages breaches of driving and rest time rules.
evidence: Regolamento (CE) 561/2006, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/ALL/?uri=CELEX%3A02006R0561-20241231, art. 10(1): divieto condizionato dei pagamenti legati alla distanza.

rows.text: Vehicle ownership does not exempt the driver from penalties for their own infringements; the undertaking may also be liable under the applicable rules.
evidence: Codice della strada, art. 174, https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-174/: sanzioni al conducente e obblighi e responsabilità dell’impresa; Regolamento (CE) 561/2006, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/ALL/?uri=CELEX%3A02006R0561-20241231, art. 10(3): responsabilità dell’impresa.

rows.text: The undertaking must organize work, give appropriate instructions and check that drivers observe the prescribed times.
evidence: Regolamento (CE) 561/2006, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/ALL/?uri=CELEX%3A02006R0561-20241231, art. 10(2): organizzazione, istruzioni e controlli.

rows.text: The undertaking must organize work within the limits: daily driving is normally limited to 9 hours, extendable to 10 no more than twice a week.
evidence: Regolamento (CE) 561/2006, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/ALL/?uri=CELEX%3A02006R0561-20241231, artt. 6(1) e 10(2): limiti e obblighi organizzativi, ferme le deroghe eccezionali dell’art. 12.

rows.text: Responsibility does not rest solely with the driver: the undertaking is also liable under applicable provisions and must give instructions compatible with the limits.
evidence: Codice della strada, art. 174, https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-174/: responsabilità e sanzioni per l’impresa; Regolamento (CE) 561/2006, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/ALL/?uri=CELEX%3A02006R0561-20241231, art. 10(2)-(3): istruzioni e responsabilità.

issues.reason: Il quesito afferma che il riposo regolare è di almeno 30 ore e stampa FALSO. Il minimo legale di 45 ore implica necessariamente almeno 30 ore; non è possibile ricavare una falsità dalla formulazione effettiva.
